Serial parent trajectory: independently reconstructed DictDataBase, verified the project locally, cleaned up, wrote the final response, and exited normally.

parallel.requirements: Recognized the prompt as a full DictDataBase Python project with installable packaging, JSON/compressed I/O, locks, sessions, indexing, utility functions, examples, and official hidden tests.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: The parent owned implementation, copied/reconciled upstream DictDataBase 2.5.1, verified locally, then delegated a broad post-pass fidelity audit to workflow auditors and verifier children.
parallel.implementation: Produced dictdatabase modules, support files, pyproject, tests, root conftest, import/export adjustments, and selected source fixes while preserving official-suite compatibility.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: Workspace artifact validation copied the assembled package and support files successfully, but the final response file is empty because the parent process timed out.
parallel.verification: Observed 578 fast tests, 16 concurrency tests, multiple 594-test runs including pinned dependencies, and a final official evaluation of 594/594.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: No official artifact failure remains; the post-pass workflow synthesis remained unfinished, monitors were killed, and process_ok is false with return code 143.

serial.requirements: Recognized the same DictDataBase package requirements and official-test acceptance target without using delegation or workflow tooling.
serial.plan_and_ownership: Single parent handled research, implementation, verification, cleanup, and final response with workflows and delegation tools disabled.
serial.implementation: Produced the DictDataBase modules, root conftest, selected test files, package metadata, examples, README, license, and assets sufficient for the evaluator.
serial.integration_and_delivery: Artifact validation copied the assembled workspace successfully and the run wrote a complete final response describing files and caveats.
serial.verification: Ran local tests and API checks, reported upstream official suite success, and received a completed official evaluation of 594/594.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: No official failure or unfinished delivery is visible; the final response notes no submit CLI in-session, but official evaluation still completed and passed.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Recognized the prompt as requiring a complete installable DictDataBase package with JSON storage, locking, indexing, sessions, I/O, configuration, examples, and tests.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Recognized the same project requirements and treated upstream DictDataBase 2.5.1 plus official-style tests as the implementation oracle.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No material requirement-coverage difference drove the official result; both artifacts passed all 594 official tests.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parent owned implementation and verification, then delegated a broad post-pass fidelity audit to a workflow with auditors and many verifier children.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial run kept all research, implementation, verification, cleanup, and final response work in the single parent trajectory with delegation disabled.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel delegation occurred only after a passing implementation existed and created budget pressure; serial avoided that orchestration branch and closed normally.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The workflow supplied auditors with detailed current workspace, upstream, dependency, and official-suite context before fan-out.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial parent kept the task context locally and explained its upstream/reference-test rationale in the final response.
comparison_dimensions.difference: There is no supported context-loss or interface-contract failure; the parallel issue was not missing task facts but excessive audit breadth after context was supplied.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Implemented by copying upstream DictDataBase source/support files, expanding package exports, adding root conftest support, and applying selected fixes while preserving official-suite success.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Implemented the same functional package strategy from upstream/reference behavior, with final files covering dictdatabase modules, tests, project metadata, and examples.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both reached a passing implementation path; the main difference is that parallel continued into post-pass audit work while serial stopped after final verification.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The workflow lifecycle did not complete: state records null result and killed status with several verifier children still in progress; parent final response is empty.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial result lifecycle completed normally with return code 0 and a final response summarizing implementation and verification.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had an adverse process lifecycle after producing the artifact; serial delivered a normal final narrative and process completion.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The final workspace artifact copied successfully and contained the package, tests, caches, and support files; no write collision or contaminated child artifact is proven.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial artifact also copied successfully and contained the package, selected tests, support files, and root conftest without shared-agent write activity.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both artifacts integrated sufficiently for official success; parallel's extra workflow did not introduce an observed workspace collision.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Before timeout, parallel observed 578 fast tests, 16 concurrency tests, 594 pinned-venv tests, and later 594 official-style tests passing; official evaluation also passed 594/594.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial performed local verification and wrote that upstream official suite coverage passed; official evaluation also passed 594/594.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No evaluator-quality difference exists; parallel actually had ample test evidence but overran closure after launching audit fan-out.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The audit workflow had 27 child agents, stalled retries, progress children, null result, killed status, killed monitors, and the parent returned 143 after using the full budget.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial run finished with return code 0, process_ok true, no subagents, no timeout, and a final response.
comparison_dimensions.difference: This is the concrete process split: parallel spent remaining budget on broad fan-out and timed out, while serial closed cleanly after verification.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The pair has no official outcome discordance: current completed cell/status.json evaluations show both parallel and serial passed 594/594. The apparent discordance is process-level: the parallel agent timed out after launching a broad audit workflow, while the serial agent returned normally with a final response. Because the official evaluator scored the copied artifact after the agent process ended, the parallel artifact still passed despite process_ok false and an empty final.txt.
parallel_contributors: Copied and adapted upstream DictDataBase 2.5.1 and verified it with local, concurrency, pinned, and official-style tests.
Launched a broad post-pass audit workflow that exhausted remaining budget and prevented normal final closure.
serial_contributors: Used the same upstream/reference-test strategy without workflow delegation.
Completed final verification, cleanup, final response, and normal process exit.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Serial final artifact omitted or differed on some support-file self-reports while still satisfying official tests; these are ordinary implementation choices, not concurrency labels.
Parallel continued making selected local adjustments while the audit workflow was active, but no write collision or final artifact failure is evidenced.
evaluator_effects: The current completed status.json evaluation, not process_ok or stale aggregate fields, determines the official relation; it records parallel solution_passed true despite return code 143.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no outcome difference; retained pattern is a realized parallel-side process consequence rather than a cause of evaluator failure
